keep: Clean crisp frames that show only this creature; the transparent background stays empty. Colors, brightness, material finish and lighting stay exactly as in the still in every frame. Existing colored markings remain steady and the same size. The creature keeps its original body proportions and full silhouette inside the canvas. Keep exactly six walking legs, two pincers, one small head, two stalk eyes and one spiral shell. Shell, coral details and asymmetric pincers stay attached and the same size.

clips.idle: Subtle idle movement: small head shifts slightly, stalk eyes tilt gently and pincers adjust while six legs hold the shell.
clips.walk: Slow scuttling walk in place on six walking legs, legs alternate while the shell stays stable.
clips.attack: Moves its larger pincer forward and closes it once in the first half, then returns it to the original position.
clips.hurt: Pulls its head and pincers inward briefly and flexes the legs, then steadies.
clips.death: Walking legs fold inward, both pincers relax and the intact shell settles onto its belly, ending motionless.
